    About this item

    • 1. Perfect Fit 56-60cm & Adjustable Rope Closure Fits head circumference 56-60cm (22-23.6 inches). The adjustable rope closure provides a custom, pressure-free fit for both men and women. No tightness or headaches – comfortable all day.
    • 2. Quick-Dry & Water-Repellent Polyester Made from high-performance polyester fabric. Wicks moisture away, dries fast, and resists light rain. Ideal for outdoor sports, running, hiking, or daily wear.
    • 3. Breathable Mesh Back + Structured 5-Panel Design Classic trucker cap with mesh back panels for maximum airflow – stays cool even in hot summer. Structured foam front holds its shape. Slightly curved brim offers sun coverage without blocking vision.
    • 4. Custom Embroidery – Your Slogan, Name or Number Add your team slogan, nickname, player number, or small logo. We use professional embroidery (not heat transfer or cheap print). Send your design after ordering. (We reject trademark or offensive content.)
    • 5. Wrinkle-Resistant & Colorfast (Grade 4) Anti-wrinkle fabric stays crisp without ironing. Tested for grade 4 colorfastness – repeated washing will not fade the cap. Neat, tight stitching for long-lasting durability. Machine washable.

    Product description

    Premium Custom Hats Logo Embroidery Service

    Your Emblem, Your Hat. Embroidered Your Story with EUYAULO.

    Express your brand, team spirit, or personal style with precision-stitched custom embroidered hats. From corporate promotions to personalized casual wear, our caps act as the perfect canvas for your vision.

    5-Panel Structured Fit

    The hard-top design provides excellent structural stability, ensuring the front panel never collapses while keeping a neat, professional profile all day long.

    Tech Quick-Dry Mesh

    Lightweight, breathable polyester combined with airflow-optimized back mesh layers. Keeps you cool, dry, and fresh during outdoor sports or intense sunny days.

    Skin-Friendly Band

    Moisture-wicking inner band feels soft and fits seamlessly.

    • Material: 100% Premium Quick-Dry Polyester + High-Density Mesh
    • Structure: 5-Panel Structured Hard Top with Slightly Curved Brim
    • Closure Type: Adjustable Single-Row Plastic Snapback (56 - 61 cm / 22" - 24")
    • Customization Techniques: 3D puffy embroidery / Flat embroidery / Hand-applied rhinestones / Printing Customizable Content: Custom text / Slogans / Numbers / Logos / Copywriting / Photos / Patterns, etc.
    • Occasions: Team Events, Outdoor Sports, Running, Golf, Family Gathering, Promotion

    Engineered for Diverse Group & Personal Scenarios

    Every hat has its own story.

    Team Branding & Slogans: Align your workforce or sports crew with beautifully custom embroidered caps.

    Event Promotions: Highly dynamic merchandise for corporate giveaways, commercial events, and trade shows.

    Personal Lifestyle & Matching: Create matching couple hats, unique family matching sets, or high-end personal custom snapback cap street look.

    Product Description

    Long Description – Color: Black Custom 5-Panel Trucker Hat – Quick-Dry, Breathable Mesh Back, Ready for Your Embroidery This black polyester cap is built for active lifestyles. Whether you need a team hat, a personalized gift, or your own signature headwear, it delivers comfort and durability. Key Features: Color: Black Size: 56-60cm adjustable rope closure – one size fits most adults Material: 100% polyester (quick-dry, water-repellent) Design: 5-panel structured front + mesh back Brim: Slightly curved for classic baseball cap look Stitching: Tight and even – no loose threads Shape Retention: Hard structured front, 3D interior cutting for a natural fit Colorfastness: Grade 4 – repeated washing without fading Custom Embroidery: Order this blank cap and we will add your custom text or simple logo via professional embroidery. Perfect for: Team slogans (“GO HARD”, “CHAMPIONS”) Player numbers (“07”, “23”, “99”) Names or nicknames (“MIKE”, “CAPTAIN”, “MOM”) Small brand logos How to Order: Select color (Black) and quantity. Complete checkout. Within 1 hour, message us via Amazon with your embroidery text or logo file. We send a digital proof within 24 hours. After approval, production takes 5-7 business days, then shipping. Care: Machine wash cold, air dry. Do not bleach. The cap retains shape and color after washes. Important: Made-to-order. Fulfilled by seller (FBM). Not returnable for change of mind – only for defects or wrong design.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    • 2. Quick-Dry & Water-Repellent Polyester Made from high-performance polyester fabric. Wicks moisture away, dries fast, and resists light rain. Ideal for outdoor sports, running, hiking, or daily wear.

    Product Description

    Create your own unique look with the EUYAULO custom 5-panel baseball cap. Whether you are planning for the 250th Anniversary of American Independence or looking for the perfect Independence Day hat, this structured snapback trucker hat is the ideal choice. Our high-quality cap features premium embroidery, allowing you to showcase your custom logo, team slogan, name, or number. This patriotic baseball cap serves as a stylish 250 years commemorative cap, making it the perfect piece of USA celebration headwear for parades, public events, or personal collections. The hard-top design ensures the cap keeps its professional shape, while the integrated breathable, moisture-wicking sweatband offers all-day comfort. Featuring an adjustable snapback closure, it fits most head sizes comfortably. Whether you are hitting the golf course, going for a run, styling your streetwear, or engaging in outdoor activities, this cap is designed for versatility. Design your own custom hat today – an ideal choice for men, women, and teams looking to celebrate historical milestones in style.
